remarks: Downtown living does not get any better. A spotless updated 1-bedroom apartment at an amazing price. This move-in-ready home offers a spacious and bright living room that accesses a private balcony with appealing city views. The dining room area leads into the well-equipped kitchen with a stainless-steel refrigerator and dishwasher along with a gas cooktop and oven. A well-sized bedroom with multiple closets and a newer bathroom. Heat and hot water are included. There is an on-site superintendent, private storage locker, party room, and main-level laundry. This location is a short walk to the Stamford Train Station, the Town Center and all the vibrant downtown amenities that are available in Stamford. This home provides a lifestyle.
